mcp_tools.name: pricing_unit_economics_pack
mcp_tools.title: Pricing unit economics pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a pricing and unit-economics record (revenue model and recognition, pricing tiers as declared rows, discount policy with declared discount rows, unit economics, churn and the MRR bridge, reporting, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRICING_UNIT_ECONOMICS_PACK_READY / PRICING_UNIT_ECONOMICS_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed tier arithmetic, contribution-margin, break-even and MRR-bridge closure checks re-derived from the declared figures, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it recommends no price, approves no deal and projects nothing.

inputSchema.description: The pricing unit economics pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All arithmetic matches and boolean flags are set to pass. Computed spot checks: contribution_margin_ratio = 0.800000, break_even_units = 6.250000.
